credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Atropa belladonna, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atropa_belladonna . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Atropa belladonna. BRACED: a low, wide, dark green sprout of soft oval leaves crouched over its own black shadow pool; the big lead leaf raised across the front like a shield, the head leaf leaning at the foe, and one closed dull-purple bell bud hanging on a curved stalk below the lead leaf. Gesture: the bud swings on its stalk while the lead leaf lifts, then settles; the stem, the other leaves and the shadow stay fixed. A deep green dark slot (leaves, stems, calyces, the bells' green base) under a dull violet mid tone (the bells and the bud); the berries are the outline black with white glints. Sport: Atropa belladonna var. lutea, the rare natural form with pale-yellow flowers and fruit (the black berries cannot change in a sport, so only the flowers turn pale yellow).
